topics.name: Requirements
topics.guidance: Agree on product behavior, measurable quality targets and the stated exercise workload. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Functional scope
concepts.guidance: Prioritize publish/read/follow and privacy; keep search, notifications and sophisticated recommendations optional.

concepts.name: Core operations and users
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Functional scope. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Quality targets
concepts.guidance: Separate media durability, metadata freshness, private visibility and feed response latency.

concepts.name: Latency and availability targets
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Quality targets. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Capacity estimates
concepts.guidance: Use the fictional baseline or state a justified alternative; derive average and peak rates and distinguish payload bytes from replication and indexes.

concepts.name: Daily volume divided by 86400
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Capacity estimates. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

topics.name: High Level Design
topics.guidance: Separate media bytes, post metadata, follower relationships and feed serving. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Publication boundary
concepts.guidance: Describe media upload and a post service that publishes only durable, accessible content.

concepts.name: Media upload service
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Publication boundary. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Feed boundary
concepts.guidance: Separate follower lookup, candidate feed references and read serving; services may be colocated.

concepts.name: Follower graph
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Feed boundary. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Persistent storage
concepts.guidance: Include durable post and relationship storage as well as object storage; caches are not the only copy.

concepts.name: Post database
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Persistent storage. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Optional extensions
concepts.guidance: A search index or recommendation service is not required for a correct baseline.

concepts.name: Search index
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Optional extensions. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

topics.name: Core Flow
topics.guidance: Connect the media pipeline with a defensible feed-generation strategy. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Media publication
concepts.guidance: Upload to object storage, validate/checksum and create derivatives asynchronously; do not expose an unfinished asset.

concepts.name: Durable media reference
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Media publication. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Fanout strategy
concepts.guidance: Choose write fanout, read fanout or a hybrid, explaining the read/write tradeoff and high-degree authors.

concepts.name: Fanout on write or read
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Fanout strategy. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Feed ordering
concepts.guidance: A reverse-chronological baseline is acceptable; use a stable tie-breaker and defend any ranking signal.

concepts.name: Chronological or scored ordering
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Feed ordering. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Visibility filtering
concepts.guidance: Apply current visibility/deletion rules when serving feed references rather than trusting stale fanout forever.

concepts.name: Read-time visibility check
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Visibility filtering. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

topics.name: Data Model
topics.guidance: Model social relationships and media references without storing blobs in relational rows. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Post records
concepts.guidance: Represent author, post ID, creation time, media manifest, visibility and deletion version.

concepts.name: Post metadata
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Post records. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Relationship records
concepts.guidance: Index follows by follower and author; make like/follow operations idempotent.

concepts.name: Follower and following indexes
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Relationship records. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Feed cursors
concepts.guidance: Page by stable ordering key rather than deep offsets; handle deletion and repeated page requests.

concepts.name: Timestamp plus post ID
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Feed cursors. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Engagement records
concepts.guidance: Represent retried likes with a unique key and comments with post-scoped ordering, author access checks and deletion semantics.

concepts.guidance: A supporting example for engagement records; accept equivalent idempotent relationship models.

topics.name: Reliability
topics.guidance: Handle publication retries, stale feeds and access revocation safely. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Retry correctness
concepts.guidance: Use stable event IDs and idempotent derivative/fanout writes; reconcile metadata and objects after partial failure.

concepts.name: Idempotent event handling
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Retry correctness. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Privacy and deletion

concepts.name: Visibility version
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Privacy and deletion. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Degraded operation
concepts.guidance: Bound worker backlogs and allow stale eligible feeds during a cache or ranking outage.

concepts.name: Queue lag limits
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Degraded operation. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

topics.name: Scaling
topics.guidance: Budget media bytes separately from post and feed metadata. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.guidance: Derive about 2.10 TB/day of source photos and 62.91 TB in a 30-day cohort before copies, derivatives and video.

concepts.name: Cache and delivery
concepts.guidance: Use bounded feed caches and CDN delivery of media; clients fetch media from the CDN/object path, not through an API-to-CDN RPC.
